text:
```yaml
name: Mobile Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'mobile-v*'

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bundle install

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          bin/rails db:migrate RAILS_ENV=test
          bin/rails test test/models/family_test.rb

      - name: Run Rubocop
        run: bin/rubocop

      - name: Create Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          name: Mobile Release ${{ github.ref_name }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
```
